why: In block 9 the reader quotes +18, −1,390 and +342 under "העלות אצלכם, לעומת הזוג השני" and asks "Plus and minus of what? Is +342 in tax good for me or bad?" They can't tell whether a sign there is good or bad, which matches the problem. It comes after four other complaints: whether money is safe at Pesagot, the foreign-fund line, the inflation button, and the unnamed "next pair".
